source_text: Quadraginta milia virorum accincti transierunt ad pugnam in conspectu Domini ad expugnandam Hiericho. Qui sunt accincti? Paulus: Estote accincti lumbos vestros in veritate. Si veritas cingulum nostrum, cum mendacium de ore procedit discingimur a militia Christi. Non sufficit apud homines veritatem videri — in conspectu Domini servanda est, etiam quae in corde Deus perspicit. Qui loquuntur pacem cum proximo, mala in cordibus — absque his sit qui accinctus ad expugnandam Hiericho procedit.
pass_a_gloss: Forty thousand of-men girded crossed unto battle in sight of-Lord unto assaulting Jericho. Who are girded? Paul: Be girded loins your in truth. If truth belt our, when lie from mouth proceeds we-are-ungirded from militia of-Christ. Not it-suffices among men truth to-seem — in sight of-Lord it-must-be-kept, also things which in heart God looks-through. Who speak peace with neighbor, evils in hearts — without these let-him-be who girded unto assaulting Jericho advances.
pass_b_english: [[Forty thousand girded men crossed to fight before the Lord, to take Jericho >> Bible:Joshua 4:13]]. Who are the girded? Hear Paul: [[Stand therefore, having girded your loins with truth >> Bible:Ephesians 6:14]]. If truth is our belt for Christ’s warfare, when a lie leaves our mouth we are ungirded from his service. It is not enough to seem truthful before people — truth must be kept [[in the Lord’s sight >> Bible:Joshua 4:13]], even what God sees in the heart. Of those who [[speak peace with their neighbor while evil is in their hearts >> Bible:Psalm 28:3]] — let the one who advances girded against Jericho be free of all that.
